entity_name: South Lebanon Water Establishment (مؤسسة مياه لبنان الجنوبي)

facts.value: South Lebanon Water Establishment. Manages drinking-water distribution, wastewater collection/treatment/disposal, customer-service faults, billing, e-payment, and district distribution follow-up for South Lebanon and Nabatieh. Complaint domains encoded for routing: water_outage, dirty_water, pipe_leak_public, water_pressure_low, meter_billing_dispute, new_water_connection, water_contamination, sewage_overflow_public, service_request.

Not responsible for / boundary conditions: electricity; road_damage; private_plumbing; storm_drain_without_sewer_evidence; Litani_Qasimiya_RasAlAin_irrigation_assets; Route instead to LRA_OR_HITL when Complaint references LRA project canal collective irrigation or Qasimiya/Ras Al Ain context.; private_plumbing_or_building_tank; Route instead to PRIVATE_PROPERTY_OR_BUILDING_MANAGEMENT when No public network or district-wide evidence.
facts.notes: Runtime cases may still require HITL when asset ownership, location, or public/private responsibility is ambiguous.
